changeSet.author: savvy
changeSet.sql: UPDATE event_bookings_summary s SET total_bookings = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.event_id = s.event_id), confirmed_bookings = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.event_id = s.event_id AND b.cancelled = false), cancelled_bookings = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.event_id = s.event_id AND b.cancelled = true), pending_bookings = 0, num_of_participants = GREATEST(0, COALESCE( (SELECT e.max_participants FROM events e WHERE e.id = s.event_id) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.event_id = s.event_id AND b.cancelled = false), 0 )), last_updated = NOW()
